START1.MES.440:
NECROMANCER: Well, that's that.
Our fight is over.
START1.MES.442:
NECROMANCER: Heading back to the
Celestial World. No place for me
here.
START1.MES.443:
Don't know what the future holds
for this place,
START1.MES.444:
but I'll do everything I can to
drive back whatever evil threatens
it.
START1.MES.445:
Still, if you need me again,
your pendant can summon me.
START1.MES.446:
Glad I could help out. Good
luck, kid.
START1.MES.449:
SUMMONER: Congrats! You must
be pretty happy.
START1.MES.450:
And I'm glad I helped bring back
order to a world clearly slipping
into chaos.
START1.MES.452: But mine is just getting started.
START1.MES.453:
I was taken into Gaia's care when
I was just a little kid.
START1.MES.454:
Now that I know his true side,
I have to search for my real roots.
I don't know who my parents are.
START1.MES.455:
But they're out there somewhere
in this world, I just know it!
START1.MES.456:
My quest is to find them, and
find myself along the way. I'm
going to go look for them.
START1.MES.460:
WARLOCK: Congratulations. Your
quest is complete.
START1.MES.463:
WARLOCK: You must start rebuilding
what you once had.
START1.MES.464:
It is too perilous for me to stay
here. I hold too much power.
START1.MES.465:
Excess power breeds needless
bloodshed. You should see that
by now. I must leave this place.
START1.MES.466:
I will go into hiding and live
out my days in peace.
START1.MES.467:
Do not let appearances fool you, I
have already lived several hundred
years. It is time I rested awhile.
START1.MES.468:
Farewell. Live a good life.
Do you hear me?
START1.MES.470:
JUSTICE: Congratulations. Your war
is finally over.
START1.MES.473:
JUSTICE: The world has been scarred
by war.
START1.MES.474:
I have a new journey to walk,
to mend it and right the wrongs
that were done.
START1.MES.475:
Please understand... this is
where our paths must part.
START1.MES.476:
Yet know that your actions were
just.
START1.MES.477:
May you keep faith in
justice and balance... Goodbye.
START1.MES.480:
IROS: Thanks.
I couldn't have done it alone.
START1.MES.481:
FORTUNER: Stop it, you're making
me blush... oh well, you're
welcome.
START1.MES.482:
I just did what I felt was
right.
START1.MES.483:
You did a fantastic job too.
We make a great team, you and I.
START1.MES.484:
Well, my quest is over now...
I guess this is goodbye.
START1.MES.486:
FORTUNER: Well, I can't stick around
forever, you know.
START1.MES.487: I've grown pretty fond of you.
START1.MES.488:
It's just that Earthland isn't
my home.
START1.MES.489:
Better stop talking like this...
it'll make saying goodbye
even harder.
START1.MES.492:
SHADOW MASTER: It's over... our
journey is done.
START1.MES.494:
SHADOW MASTER: That was
quite a fight.
START1.MES.495:
Glad I could help swing
things our way.
START1.MES.496:
Your cause is proven,
and my part here is done.
START1.MES.499:
Back when I trained with Gaia,
I gained too much power. You have
to see it has to be this way.
START1.MES.500:
I can't exist in a world
with no conflict, no war.
START1.MES.501:
In times of peace, I have no
choice but to disappear.
START1.MES.502:
The end will soon be a new start.
Rest assured, this peace won't
last.
START1.MES.503:
When you've got another fight
to wage, call me, and I'll be
right there.
START1.MES.504:
Find a worthy cause and I'll have
your back. We'll cross paths again
soon enough.
START1.MES.506:
IROS: Wait, Shadow Master! Tell
me what you mean.

tutorial.06G:
SUMMON: Use this command to
summon a monster, who will
become your ally.

This command allows you to summon
a monster from the Nether World
who will help fight your battles.

You can use the SUMMON command only
when the Master is on top of
a magic tower.

SUMMON won't work if the
Master is in a fortress or on
a castle wall.

When you use the SUMMON command,
you first select the location where
the monster is to be summoned.

A monster can be summoned
only to a hex adjacent to the
Master's location.
tutorial.08I:
PLACE: This command enables you
to place monsters you have nurtured
on the map.

This command is similar to the
SUMMON command. Select the location
where you wish to place the monster.

The monster can be placed only
within a 1-hex area surrounding
the Master.
tutorial.09J:
Next, select the monster you wish
to place, and confirm your selection
by pressing the X button.

The monster you have selected will
then appear on the map.

You can use the placed
monster starting with
your next turn (phase).
tutorial.10K:
SPELL: This command enables
you to use powerful magic spells.

You can use spells to attack your
enemy or restore the strength of
an ally.

You can also use them to raise a
monster's status temporarily.

When you execute the SPELL command,
you'll see a list showing the spells
you can use.

At the bottom of the list, you'll
see the effects of the spell you
have highlighted.

Select the spell you wish to use
and press the X button.
tutorial.11L:
ITEM: This command enables you to
use an item you have acquired.

You may sometimes find items when
you occupy a magic tower.

Items can inflict damage on the
enemy.

They can also increase an ally's
attack power or defensive strength.

When you execute the ITEM
command, you'll see a list of
items you can use.

At the bottom of the list is a
description of the effects of
the item you have chosen.

The number next to an item tells
you how many times you can use it.

Select an item from the list and
press the X button.
tutorial.15P:
Congratulations, Iros!

You did a fine job of defeating
my army.

I think you now have a good idea
of the game sequence.

You can use the monsters you
nurtured on this map when you
go to the next map.

When you start the next map, try
using the PLACE command.

Oh, wait a minute! There's
something you have to do
when you complete a map.

You have to
ARRANGE THE MONSTERS.
tutorial.16Q:
Oh, no! There's fog all over
the place!

Fog will hamper your visibility.
Enemy units will only be visible
from a certain distance.

What you do in this situation is
called a "search operation."

The current visibility range is the
Master's search operation range
(as far as you can see on the map).

The size of the search operation
range is a unit's mobility range
+ 1 adjacent hex.

You can see a display of each
unit's search operation by pressing
the SELECT button.

Now you need to summon a monster
to scout the enemy.

For reasons that I mentioned
earlier, you'll need a monster
with a lot of mobility.

The Unicorn, Roc, and other
flying units make good scouts.

When you begin the map, send
these monsters off in various
directions, and find the enemy army.

Oh, yes. Shade, a character in
Gaia's army, can be counted
on to produce fog.

If you defeat Shade, the fog will
be dispelled, and you'll be able
to see the entire map.

So, if you want to make things
easy for yourself,

it's a good idea to get rid of
Shade first.
tutorial.21V:
SKILL CHART: Here you
can see the skills of all units
on the map.

Move the directional buttons
up and down and press SELECT
button while the SKILL CHART

is being displayed,

you'll see data on the units and
their categories. (Press ▲ button
to return to the SKILL CHART.)

If you press the START button
while the SKILL CHART is
being displayed,

you can change the name of the unit
on which the cursor is positioned.

SKILL VALUES: These represent a
unit's current status.

By pressing the L1 and R1 buttons,
you can switch to a display in
graph form.

UNIT NAME: Here you'll see the
name of a unit and its attribute.

The letter that appears before
a unit's name represents its
attribute.

For each unit, you'll see LAW,
NEUTRAL, or CHAOS displayed.

The attributes can have a
significant effect on a unit's
strength at a particular time.

Law is strong in the daytime, but
weak at night. Chaos is strong at
night, but weak during the day.

Units with the Neutral attribute
are not affected by time.

Summoning monsters with attributes
opposite of the Master's will
require more INT than normal.

LV (Level): This represents a
unit's level.

When a specific level is
exceeded, you can shift
the unit to another class.

EX (Experience): This represents
a unit's experience value.

When this value reaches 100, the
unit moves up one level.

HP (Hit Points): These represent a
unit's physical strength.

Suppose the display shows 85/130,
current strength being 85. 130 is
the maximum physical strength.

When you switch to graph display,
you'll see that the graph descends
going from right to left.

MP (Magic Points): These represent
the number of attacks each unit with
magic attack capability can make.

Suppose you have a unit with
3 MP and two magic attacks.

That means that it can launch two
attacks during the first attack.

But it can't attack a second time.

(This situation tends to occur
during your opponent's turn.)

This value is restored when you
take your next turn, if you're on
top of a magic tower.

INT (Intelligence): This represents
the ruling power you need to
summon a monster.

This displays the MP value of spells
for the Master only.

AG (Agility): This represents the
unit's speed.

The higher this value, the easier
it is to attack an enemy.

E (End Mark): This shows
activity status.

NOT PLACED: This means that a unit
has not been done. NO SYMBOL: Action
done. Blue O: Summon or place units.
tutorial.31f:
RAPHAEL: Hello, Iros.

When new elements appear, I'll
explain them to you.

Don't indulge in useless
speculation, like "I thought
you were dead."

Remember you can use
the PLACE command.

This enables you to use the monsters
you used on the previous screen.

You also need this command
to nurture monsters, so try
using it once.

encyclopedia.000:
The eldest of Gaia's six disciples,
though he looks like a boy. He keeps
that form out of longing for the
innocence of childhood, so many take
him for an arrogant upstart. Awed by
Gaia's power when they first met, he
chose to become his disciple. A
master of magic, he fights with a
magic staff.
encyclopedia.001:
A cheerful, hot-blooded type who
never betrays anyone who's gained
his trust. He becomes Gaia's
disciple to honor the deathbed wish
of a friend. He recognizes Gaia's
skills, but distrusts Gaia. His
skill levels vary wildly.
His special item is a morningstar.
encyclopedia.002:
A beautiful young girl on her way to
becoming a Master. She often needs
help, and devotes herself to anyone
who treats her kindly. Her specialty
is summoning, and her weapon is a
scepter.
encyclopedia.007:
A warrior who has earned the right
to call himself a Dragon Slayer in
his quest for fame and fortune.
Slaying a dragon takes rare skill
and strength, and those who have
done it shine on any battlefield.
encyclopedia.008:
The sword is his art and his way of
life. A swordsman's only joy is
cutting down an opponent quickly and
cleanly.
encyclopedia.009:
A warrior from the far East. Samurai
shun heavy armor, and their long
swords are frighteningly sharp. They
may look strange, but their
swordsmanship is dazzling: most foes
fall to a single stroke.
encyclopedia.136:
A stern, unbending Master who lives
by her own code of justice.
Believing Gaia shared it, she became
his disciple. Now that he has
strayed, she is set on stopping him,
even if it costs them both their
lives. Skilled in both magic and the
sword, she wields a huge magic
blade.
encyclopedia.139:
A genius born in the heavens, with
immense magic and overwhelming
charisma. When the Celestial World
grew troubled by Earthland and the
Nether World, Gaia was the first to
act, descending to Earthland with
his six disciples. There he defied
the Celestial World, summoned
monsters from the Nether World and
set out to conquer the land. What is
he truly after?
encyclopedia.003:
A soldier trained in many styles of
combat, ready to do whatever a
battle demands. He excels at
fighting in formation rather than
one-on-one.
encyclopedia.004:
A battle-hardened hero who has
survived countless wars. Fighters
forge their own sword techniques and
have never known defeat. To them,
losing is as bad as dying.
encyclopedia.005:
A knight pledges his life to his
lord. Knights are fine warriors and
skilled lancers. Honor means
everything to them, and they fight
bravely for the cause of justice.
encyclopedia.006:
A proud lancer who holds truth and
justice above all else. Paladins can
still be seen riding across
battlefields to protect the ones
they love.
encyclopedia.010:
A member of a vast underground guild
who lives by stealing and spying.
Now and then he takes to the
battlefield as a scout.
encyclopedia.011:
A cold-blooded assassin who will use
any means to finish the job. Ninjas
strike under cover of darkness,
quickly and silently.
encyclopedia.012:
A warrior who rides into battle on a
dragon, bound to it by mutual trust.
Dragons are said to be keen judges
of character, so few ever become
Dragon Knights.
encyclopedia.013:
A child of the wilds, more beast
than man to most eyes. Barbarians
fight with tactics no one can
predict. Anyone foolish enough to
attack one will regret it.
encyclopedia.014:
He seems like any other warrior
until the fighting starts. Then he
changes completely. Born for battle,
a berserker fights with superhuman
strength and stamina.
encyclopedia.015:
Not pride but grim resolve drives
the Death Knight. His creed: leave
your feelings off the battlefield.
One false step could cost him what
little humanity he has left.
encyclopedia.016:
A knight who has fought so many wars
that only victory matters to him
now. He will do whatever it takes to
grow stronger.
encyclopedia.017:
An apprentice still learning his
craft. Drawn in by the mystery of
magic, he spends his days studying
how to bend its power to his will.
encyclopedia.018:
A shaman uses magic to sway the
human spirit and draws on the four
elements: fire, air, water and
earth. Shamans are peaceful souls
who dislike war.
encyclopedia.019:
A magician proud of his intellect,
versed in many kinds of magic.
Wizards spend their lives in study,
so they have few skills for close
combat.
encyclopedia.020:
A master magician who has learned
advanced spells and ancient lore.
His power spans every art known to
humankind. High Wizards stand at the
peak of their craft.
encyclopedia.021:
A spirit of tremendous magical
power, highest of all beings that
have overcome death. It looks like a
skeleton, with an eerie glow in its
sunken eyes. Proud of its mastery,
it keeps all others at a distance,
and is known as the Undying King.
encyclopedia.022:
A zealot devoted to the gods.
Ancients believe that worship brings
good fortune, and spend all their
time in strict ritual.
encyclopedia.023:
Chosen by the gods, priests have
mastered sacred spells said to have
been left on Earth by the gods
themselves. They use the power
gained through ascetic practice to
save others.
encyclopedia.024:
A warrior priest who guards shrines
and villages. Monks train their
bodies through ascetic practice, and
use them as weapons to protect the
innocent.
encyclopedia.025:
A high-ranking knight with great
charisma. Lords excel at close
combat as well as strategy. They
read a battle calmly and quickly,
and make superb commanders.
encyclopedia.075:
The Cockatrice is a composite
creature: part lizard, part rooster,
and part bat. Its beak turns anyone
it touches to stone. Despite the
fact that it's a chimera, it and
its kind live in the material world.
encyclopedia.069:
A lion with an eagle's head and
great wings. Griffins nest on
mountainsides and cliffs and fly
with ease. They roam vast
territories, sometimes straying into
villages or onto roads.
encyclopedia.123:
A lion's body, a bat's wings and a
man's head, with a tail bristling
with spines. The manticore loves
human flesh and sometimes stakes out
a territory near a village to prey
on its people.
encyclopedia.122:
A goat above the waist and a lion
below, with dragon-like wings
sprouting from its back. It has
three heads: a lion's, a goat's and
a ferocious dragon's. The Chimera is
said to have been made by a powerful
magician.
encyclopedia.071:
A giant bird of countless legends.
Its wingspan is more than a dozen
meters. Shaped like an eagle with
sharp, hooked talons, the Roc swoops
down from the sky on its prey. Being
so huge, it hunts large game, and
sometimes livestock.
encyclopedia.072:
The Firebird's body is covered
with scarlet flames. It looks like
a phoenix, but is less intelligent.
Legend has it that the Firebird
is an early stage in the Phoenix's
development.
encyclopedia.073:
A legendary bird wreathed in scarlet
flame. It has the power of
immortality and is said to rule over
rebirth and destruction. In battle
it soars through the sky, wielding
its flames. Little is known of its
life, but many peoples tell tales of
it.
encyclopedia.074:
This monstrous bird is a type
of Firebird. Instead of immortal
power, it has been endowed with
the power to manipulate thunder.
encyclopedia.091:
Skeletons are raised by the dark
magic of evil sorcerers to serve as
guards. They have no special skills
and can follow only simple orders,
but in large numbers they are
deadly.
encyclopedia.092:
The walking dead. Like skeletons,
zombies are raised by evil
magicians. Those raised on the
battlefield are often missing a
limb, so they move slowly and
stagger as they walk.
encyclopedia.087:
The Vampire stalks silently through
the night. It is evil and shows its
victims no mercy. It looks like a
handsome human, but its skin is pale
to the point of being see-through.
encyclopedia.080:
When the dead cling too tightly to
the world of the living, they become
ghosts. Their bodies are
see-through, and since they are
spirits, weapons barely harm them.
encyclopedia.086:
The ghost of a woman who died of a
broken heart. Legend says that
anyone who hears her wail will meet
misfortune, and her cry does carry a
powerful curse.
encyclopedia.083:
A being born of the unresolved
feelings of the dead. Some phantoms
have a purpose of their own, and
they are said to devour the souls of
the living.
encyclopedia.084:
A ghost that haunts ruins and other
forsaken places. It drains the life
of anyone it touches.
encyclopedia.081:
Called an Apparition because it has
no visible body. It is a spirit, yet
not born of its own will or of
hatred: it is said to have been made
by ancient human magic.
encyclopedia.082:
A strong-willed human who refuses to
die. Wraiths look vaguely human, but
their forms are blurred, and they
are doomed to wander with no place
in the world.
encyclopedia.085:
A spirit left behind by someone who
died with wicked thoughts. It dwells
mostly in the spirit world, so the
physical world can barely touch it.
encyclopedia.093:
A corpse preserved by the burial
rites of desert lands, risen to take
revenge on the living. Mummies hit
hard, but the linen wrappings that
preserve them make them highly
vulnerable to fire.
encyclopedia.076:
A hound from the underworld with
rabid eyes and flames spilling from
its jaws. It moves swiftly, and its
magical fire is very hard to put
out.
encyclopedia.078:
A gigantic three-headed dog whose
presence fills every living thing
with terror. The way it hunts its
prey lives up to its name: the
Watchdog of Hell.
encyclopedia.079:
A wolf-man who can take the form of
a wolf, with a beast's strength and
a human's mind. Werewolves live in
packs but always hunt alone.
encyclopedia.043:
A man-made beast that looks like a
bat-winged demon. Magicians first
brought stone statues to life to
create it, but carved them in such
detail that they came to live on as
a species of their own.
encyclopedia.134:
A shapeless mass of cells. Slimes
love damp places such as caves and
underground mazes. They hide behind
objects and ambush whatever passes
by.
encyclopedia.070:
A cross between a horse and a
griffin: it has a griffin's head and
wings on a horse's body. Odd as it
looks, it is a superb flyer with a
horse's stamina.
encyclopedia.067:
A one-horned beast that lives in
forests far from human towns. The
magic of its horn is said to let it
live for centuries. A lonely unicorn
may sometimes be tamed by someone
pure of heart.
encyclopedia.068:
A graceful winged horse with pure
white feathers. Clever but wild, it
is hard to tame, but once tamed it
makes a superb war horse.
encyclopedia.089:
A spirit of the air and ruler of the
winds, it travels inside a
whirlwind. Only a powerful magician
can summon it into this world, and
rarely.
encyclopedia.090:
Guardian of the flame sprites, this
demonic being controls destruction
by fire. He is the polar opposite of
the Genie, and his constant rival.
Like the Genie, he can be summoned
but is extremely difficult to
control.
encyclopedia.113:
A giant octopus of the open sea that
seizes its prey with its eight long,
nimble arms. It sometimes attacks
ships, and fishermen fear it.
encyclopedia.114:
No one has ever seen more than the
huge tentacles of this sea beast,
hence its name. Nothing else is
known about it, except that it is
savage and very dangerous.
encyclopedia.116:
The demon of the sea, dwelling on
the deepest ocean floor. To glimpse
it is said to mean death. It is
blamed for tidal waves and the ebb
and flow of the tides, and some
coastal peoples worship it as a wild
sea god.
encyclopedia.058:
A sylph who appears as a naked young
woman you can barely see. She is the
wind itself, and only sometimes can
her beauty be seen glinting in the
sunlight.
encyclopedia.059:
A kind-hearted wind spirit who
understands human speech and guides
lost travelers. But anger her, and
her power over the air can snuff out
a human life with ease.
encyclopedia.029:
Female warriors, guardians of
Valhalla, they are dignified and
extremely beautiful in battle. They
boost the moral of troops on the
battlefield, and severely discourage
the enemy. They are extremely
valuable and treasured for this
power.
encyclopedia.088:
A seductive demoness who lures men
with her beauty, then kills them.
She is said to be a sorceress who
made a pact with the Prince of
Darkness.
encyclopedia.125:
A humanoid monster with a bull's
head. It lives mostly in underground
mazes, feeding on the people who
wander into its lair.
encyclopedia.126:
A small humanoid with a dog-like
face and no fur: timid, yet vicious.
It is not very strong, but it is as
clever as a human and handy with
tools.
encyclopedia.124:
A monster with a lion's body and a
human head. Strange as it looks, it
commands great magic and a brilliant
mind. Proud of its wisdom, it asks a
riddle of everyone who enters its
land, and kills all who cannot
answer.
encyclopedia.127:
A small humanoid that lives in caves
and tunnels. Goblins are wicked,
raiding towns and villages with
simple tactics. They hate sunlight
and rarely stir during the day.
encyclopedia.128:
A boar-faced humanoid that eats
meat. Orcs form tribes that live by
hunting and raiding, and wage war
again and again to widen their
lands.
encyclopedia.130:
A giant statue created from materials
in the natural world, and housing a
sprite. The spell for creating them
is shrouded in mystery, and only a
few strong magicians can create a
golem. Magicians who can create
golems are said to kill earth
sprites and trap their souls within
the golem.
encyclopedia.098:
Also known as the King of Dragons.
With his immense size, unmatched
might, and venomous blood, he
possesses the power to vanquish all
who oppose him. Legend states that
he brings nothing but bloodshed to
the righteous.
encyclopedia.101:
A giant dragon that flies the night
sky on four bat-like wings. It is
often seen at night, and is said to
glow in the dark.
encyclopedia.097:
A cruel, savage dragon that will not
tolerate any other kind of creature.
Death Dragons love fighting other
species and are always locked in
battles to the death.
encyclopedia.102:
Bahamut spent long
ages gathering its strength. He
understands human speech, and
boasts a high intellect, strong
magic, and solid physique.
encyclopedia.056:
A tiny, adorable creature that looks
like a winged human. Fairies are
said to bring good luck, so people
are always trying to catch them and
sell them for a high price.
encyclopedia.050:
Forest dwellers who look much like
humans, but are smaller and
slighter. Elves are very beautiful,
and their speech sounds like song.
They love nature, hate anyone who
defiles their woods, and are fine
archers.
encyclopedia.051:
An elf gifted in magic. High Elves
live for several human generations,
spending much of that time studying
magic and honing their
swordsmanship.
encyclopedia.052:
An elf devoted to culture, with
traditions all its own. Master Elves
find joy in poetry and music and
truly hate fighting. They live in
peace deep in the woods, far from
humans.
encyclopedia.055:
The highest of all elves and their
ruler. His intellect is superior,
and he surpasses other elves in
every way, magic and combat
included.
encyclopedia.053:
An elf with a spirit of darkness.
Dark Elves once loved the forest
like their kin, but their evil
hearts changed their looks long ago.
Unlike other elves, they are always
at war.
encyclopedia.054:
A Dark Elf who has deepened its
darkness through black magic. This
sinister forest dweller is said to
draw great magical power from that
darkness.
encyclopedia.031:
A female magician. Women who study
magic are rare and often thought
strange, but she pays no mind to
what others think, and keeps on with
her research.
encyclopedia.032:
A magician who has earned the title
of Mage through years of intense
study. A pitiable soul who finds
meaning in nothing but magic.
encyclopedia.033:
A female magician of great, precise
magical power. Besides ordinary
spells, she knows magic all her own,
which makes her a strong weapon on
the battlefield.
encyclopedia.107:
The highest and strongest of all
dragons. King Dragons have lived for
thousands of years, their scales are
as hard as steel, and their
legendary wings blot out the sky.
encyclopedia.035:
A woman who has given her life to
the gods. Neophytes are not strong
on their own, but they always strive
to guide people down the right path
through the teachings of the gods.
encyclopedia.036:
A woman who guides people toward the
gods, working heavenly miracles for
human happiness and a peaceful
world. Her miracles are so powerful
that priestesses are often taken
into battle against their will.
encyclopedia.037:
A devout follower of the gods with a
great spirit. Often called the voice
of the gods, he can work very
powerful heavenly miracles.
encyclopedia.106:
A vicious humanoid reptile that
lives near water. It fights on its
own and may seem a poor fit for an
army, but used well, it can be a
vital asset.
encyclopedia.034:
A woman holding the rank of bishop
who can also use magic. She is
highly educated and deeply learned
in magic, and very powerful on the
battlefield.
encyclopedia.096:
A dragon that commands fire. It is
known for striking before intruders
even reach its territory, and many
travelers have died in a sudden ball
of flame.
encyclopedia.060:
The highest of the wind spirits,
with a brilliant mind. It rarely
shows itself to humans, and only
magicians with strong power over
spirits can summon it.
encyclopedia.045:
An archangel who brings messages
from the gods to Earthland. He links
humankind and the gods, and priests
find him more approachable than the
gods themselves. He was a mighty
warrior in the Celestial World.
encyclopedia.133:
A gigantic fish-shaped life form
living in the ocean. It causes
whirlpools when it sucks in its
prey with seawater. Its dorsal fin
is sharp, and it occasionally sinks
ships.
encyclopedia.115:
Said to be a mutant octopus or
Tentacles, it is so huge it seems
impossible that it exists in nature.
A ferocious meat-eater of the open
sea.
encyclopedia.061:
A creature with a muscular body
covered in tough hide. Trolls can
live anywhere. When hungry, a troll
will keep fighting until its prey is
dead.
encyclopedia.062:
A huge, human-shaped creature nearly
twice the height of a troll, strong
enough to shatter rock. Giants have
their own language but little wit,
and fight with brute strength and
clubs.
encyclopedia.063:
A race of one-eyed giants. They
usually live deep in the forest, but
are far from peaceful, and their
neighbors live in fear of them.
encyclopedia.064:
They look like giants, but are a
completely different race. Colossi
live in camps and hunt for a living.
Perhaps it is their warlike nature:
now and then they attack merchants
and travelers for food.
encyclopedia.065:
Giants of the frozen north. Built to
endure the cold, they hide in the
snow to ambush creatures that wander
too close.
encyclopedia.066:
Giants who roam the ice plains as
nomads, never settling in one place.
They are calm, dislike fighting, and
rarely show themselves to humans.
encyclopedia.111:
A sea dragon cursed by the gods,
hiding in the depths of the dark
ocean. It was born of an ancient war
between the gods.
encyclopedia.038:
A small, human-shaped demon that
loves to tamper with tools. If your
tools suddenly break, this little
demon may be to blame.
encyclopedia.057:
A tiny fairy shaped like a little
girl, with delicate butterfly wings.
It moves so quickly that at first
glance it is often mistaken for a
butterfly.
encyclopedia.132:
A giant crab with two huge pincers
that lives on the banks of swamps
and bogs. It buries itself in the
mud with only its eyes showing, and
seizes prey passing above.
encyclopedia.135:
A giant ray that glides through the
sea like a flying carpet. It is a
majestic sight, but a very dangerous
meat-eater.
encyclopedia.039:
Demons live in the magic world and
come to this one when magicians
summon them or when they slip
through rifts in space. They are
skilled with magic and love
destruction and chaos.
encyclopedia.041:
A powerful spirit that feeds on dark
human emotions such as greed and
lust. Revered as a demigod, it has
power close to a god's, enough to
work wonders by sheer will.
encyclopedia.042:
The highest spirit in this world,
existing by its own strength alone.
Said to equal the gods and able to
create life, it is the king of the
underworld and ruler of all demons.
encyclopedia.040:
A low-ranking demon that grants the
wishes of wicked people in exchange
for their souls. When the bond
between their body and spirit
weakens, it carries their souls off
to the Nether World.
encyclopedia.105:
A gentle dragon that likes to live
close to nature. It is among the
mightiest of dragons in battle, but
will never show it by choice. A wise
and deeply thoughtful being.
encyclopedia.044:
A human-shaped being with large
white bird wings. Cherubs are very
beautiful, but have no fixed form:
each observer sees them differently.
encyclopedia.049:
A heavily armored knight who once
guarded the Celestial World.
Magicians sometimes summon one and
bind it to their will, so you may
meet one on the battlefield.
encyclopedia.048:
The mightiest of the angels who
guarded law and order in the
Celestial World, closest of all to
the gods. Few humans will ever see
one.
encyclopedia.046:
An angel of wisdom and a symbol of
harmony and balance, sent down from
the Celestial World whenever war
broke out in Earthland.
encyclopedia.047:
Guardian of the mysterious
"Sefirot", the world tree growing
somewhere in Earthland. The
seraphim can control various natural
phenomena, and destroys its enemies
with lightning.
encyclopedia.112:
A dragon with many heads, fierce,
huge, and shaped like a serpent.
It lives in oriental lands.
encyclopedia.095:
A dragon full of the spirit of
flame. It is highly resistant to
fire and lives near active
volcanoes. It controls flames by
instinct, and is very rare in the
natural world.
encyclopedia.099:
A flying dragon of deep forests and
mountains. When it hunts, it never
lets its shadow fall on its prey
before it strikes.
encyclopedia.100:
A flying dragon whose tail is more
than half its body length, tipped
with a scorpion-like stinger. The
stinger holds a deadly poison that
it uses to kill its prey.
encyclopedia.131:
A magical being existing in the
spirit world. He has three faces
representing good, evil, and
neutral attributes, and he has four
sets of arms. He can only be
summoned by magic.
encyclopedia.077:
A savage, meat-eating beast much
like a wolf. Hounds always hunt in
packs.
encyclopedia.120:
A greedy meat-eater with a woman's
face and body, and a bird's wings
and talons. Its hunger never ends,
and it preys on every kind of
creature.
encyclopedia.030:
A mighty warrior woman who takes the
battlefield by storm. She is skilled
at both magic and close combat. Her
presence lifts her allies and
strikes fear into her foes.
encyclopedia.108:
This great sea serpent is feared
by all sailors. It prefers to
attack ships carrying humans.
Wrapping itself around the
ship, it snaps it in two and
swallows the sailors as they fall.
encyclopedia.109:
Sea Dragons live in the ocean. Their
extremely long bodies let them swim
at great speed.
encyclopedia.094:
A rather common dragon. He lives
everywhere from forests and plains
to shorelines. Though it is a
dragon, its intellect is not very
high. It lives simply, using
primitive hunting techniques.
encyclopedia.110:
A many-headed dragon that lives near
swamps and lakes. Its life force is
so strong that it will not die until
every head is cut off, and so it is
feared as an undying beast.
encyclopedia.117:
A river spirit with a beautiful
woman's upper body and a fish's
tail. She hates being seen by
humans, and her lovely singing voice
is famous among sailors.
encyclopedia.119:
This sea sprite sings during storms
and cries in calm weather.
Their singing has been known to
run ships aground. Sirens
themselves mean no harm,
but their songs are perilous to
mankind.
encyclopedia.118:
A half-woman, half-fish creature of
the sea, with a graceful body,
pointed ears and silver eyes. Her
beauty is strangely unlike a human
woman's.
encyclopedia.129:
A warlike folk of great fighting
skill. Many are independent warriors
who demand high pay, but they earn
every coin. Arrogant, yes, but very
capable.
encyclopedia.104:
A holy beast of the forest with a
deer's body, an ox's tail, horse's
hooves and short horns on its brow.
It is so gentle it will not harm
even the smallest creature.
encyclopedia.121:
It looks like a strange bird, but it
is the spirit of a doomed human that
curses the living and kills without
end. It delights in slaughter, and
attacks ships and towns in flocks.
encyclopedia.027:
A tribe of hunters living quietly in
an all-female society in the
unexplored north. They also love a
good fight, and are always armed.
encyclopedia.028:
This woman has attained the title
of Knight as one who places herself
in a battle-torn world for the love
of peace. Equal to any man in courage
and dignity, she has superior battle
skills.
encyclopedia.103:
A serpent-shaped dragon that prefers
human prey, rearing its head to
strike. Its fangs are highly
venomous, and its killing blows far
surpass those of other dragons.
encyclopedia.137:
Calm and composed, he hides his
feelings and carries out even the
foulest deeds without flinching. He
once broke the laws of the Celestial
World and was left for dead, but
Gaia saw his skill and took him on
as a disciple. Out of gratitude he
has handled Gaia's dirty work ever
since. Now that Gaia has cast him
aside, he must fight to survive. His
skills are balanced in every way.
encyclopedia.138:
A lighthearted tomboy who quickly
makes friends with anyone. She lost
the man she loved, and believes she
could have saved him had her magic
been stronger. To forget her grief
and train, she became Gaia's
disciple. Her weapon is a feather
fan.
encyclopedia.026:
A magician skilled in general magic.
He casts many kinds of spells
without favoring any one type, a
clear sign of his skill.
encyclopedia.140:
A legendary warrior who has always
been part of Earthland's tales. He
once slew a hundred soldiers
single-handedly.
encyclopedia.141:
Once an ordinary Earthland girl.
Iros was not the only one the
Celestial rulers gave a magic
pendant: Crusader received hers a
little earlier, along with a
floating island in the Celestial
World as her base. The rulers told
her to abandon Earthland and build a
new paradise there.
encyclopedia.142:
Emperor of the Celestial World and
once Gaia's superior. The people of
the Celestial World prized order and
could not stand the endless chaos of
Earthland and the Nether World.
Their divine punishments achieved
nothing, and they knew a new plan
was needed, but no one wanted to get
involved. Then one man stepped
forward with his own idea. His name
was Gaia.
encyclopedia.143:
Gaia's servant, a humanoid he made
from earth after sealing his own
disciples in the magic tower. He
wears the robes Gaia wore in the
Celestial World and treasures them
as a sign of Gaia's trust.
encyclopedia.144:
A messenger of the Celestial World
who brings the decisions of the gods
to Iros.
encyclopedia.145:
The mother of all monsters, who gave
birth to every beast of the Nether
World. She is as big as a mountain,
and her evil is hard to look upon.
No one knows when she was born or
where she came from. Rooted in the
ground, she devours monsters and
endlessly gives birth to new ones.
encyclopedia.146:
A hero of Earthland legend who
fought bravely beside Dias in the
War of the Gods.
encyclopedia.147:
Gaia's servant, skilled at shaping
the battlefield. Like the Dark
Bishop, he is a humanoid made from
earth. His magic is weak, and his
main task is to raise fog and sow
confusion.
encyclopedia.148:
A holy woman of Earthland legend.
She stood with the people in the
famous War of the Gods and won great
renown in battle.
